body:
Starry SATB Choir is a welcoming and diverse community mixed choir based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Our singers come from different ages, cultures, and musical backgrounds, united by a shared love of choral music.

The name “Starry” reflects our belief that every singer is a unique star. Every voice matters, and when different voices come together, they create something brighter and more beautiful.

Starry explores choral music from around the world, including classical, contemporary, traditional, and cross-cultural repertoire. We have a particular interest in sharing and celebrating Chinese and Asian musical traditions, while building meaningful connections with artists, choirs, and community organizations from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Since its founding, Starry has been actively involved in Winnipeg’s community and cultural life through concerts, cultural celebrations, and artistic collaborations. In 2026, the choir received a Gold Award at the Winnipeg Music Festival Choral Competition.

We welcome singers who love music, enjoy learning, and want to share the joy of singing with others. Whatever your musical background or experience, there is a place for your voice at Starry.

Let every voice shine. Together, we sing like stars.
以声为光，和鸣如星
